in_game_description: Good explosives are manufactured in the Nesla system and are used primarily for mining resources.
mechanics_text: 20t of Explosives are required for the AMR Extinctor blueprint.
25t of Explosives are required for the Liberator blueprint.
20t of Explosives are required for the Ion Lambda MK2 blueprint.
10t of Explosives are required for the Fireworks blueprint.
25t of Explosives are required for the Shock Blast blueprint.
The image for Explosives looks like a piece of modern-day C4.
These can be found in large quantities in Sao Perula in the Loma system, along with Radioactive Goods.
